purpose: One frozen confirmation of the CNN on a fresh synthetic test draw. Written and committed before the run; the run happens once and its result decides (orchestrator -ba, 14 Nov 2026).
models: The five leave-one-target-out fold models, rebuilt exactly as at 7ef10af (seed 20261114, 2,500 stamps per class per target, 30-epoch cap). Each must reproduce its recorded fold metrics on the original test stamps exactly, proving it is the frozen model.

freshDraw.note: Never used in training, selection or any earlier test. Same five SPHEREx fields and frames as training (only the fake injections and fake noise are new), so this is a fresh synthetic draw, not new sky.

passRule: Same gates as check(), on the mean over the 5 fields of the fresh draw: macro-F1 >= 0.80, mover recall at S/N>=10 >= 0.85, artifact precision >= 0.85, CNN macro-F1 >= trees macro-F1 + 0.01 on the same fresh stamps, CNN macro-F1 >= the round-one trees baseline + 0.01. Size and determinism are properties of the frozen model, already checked at 7ef10af. Per-field numbers are reported, not gated.

uncertainty.method: Resample each field's fresh test stamps with replacement; 95% interval of the mean artifact precision. Also the spread over the 5 fields.

runs: Exactly one. No rerun, no second seed, whatever comes out.
